scope: Ordered manifests ending at 4a4677c9329c1a8d5cb8bc0916dc331dc952219b; all frame-verified, numerically scored games, both seat perspectives; incomplete fault excluded. Select before inspecting outcomes.
split: Exact non-top-five registered names with SHA256('tenure-opponent-v1|' + name) mod 5 == 0 go exclusively to unknown-opponent evaluation. Entire such game withheld, primary unknown subset is the seat that faced the reserved opponent. For all remaining maps SHA256('tenure-map-v1|' + initial_terrain_u8_sha256) mod 8: 0 known-map test, 1 calibration, 2-7 training. Unique map ID, seed and terrain required globally. Subject to registration-name identity, aliases uncertified.
inputs: Only pre-action public CHOICE fields enumerated by model.FEATURES. No opponent/agent name, root ID, command, future decision, exact hidden board or opponent's hidden cargo input.
targets: held_transitions up to actual first transfer, natural expiry or official end
first-tenure gross cash actually credited to the buyer: absorption + collision_cash; worker absorption already included
label_scope: Conditional on a purchase actually clearing, not a causal pay/defer effect. Terminal cuts off reward at the official game end; no extrapolation beyond it.
model: Separate squared-error histogram gradient boosters for conditional mean held moves and cash; fixed 75 iterations, 15 leaves, lr=.07, min_leaf=60, L2=5. Affine per-kind calibration on separate maps, slope restricted to [0,2]. Nonnegative cash, tenure bounded by remaining game turns. Reference per-kind training means and fixed same-input per-kind ridge (L2=30).
held_measurement: All held games and all their realized acquisitions. Equal-event MAE/bias/RMSE for descriptive performance, equal-map paired MAE change vs means with 1500 whole-map bootstrap replicates. Five training-prediction quantile groups show calibration. Break out actual early loss, nonrecoup, late, new/seized and exact registered opponent counts.
native: Frozen 64 existing pay/defer original Master3s2 roots, 48+16 pre-existing split; no tuning. Choose pay if predicted own gross strictly exceeds pre-action purchase price. Report realized official chosen-branch margin and regret vs parent/all-pay/all-defer; separate own and rival final differences. Future rival denial or opportunity cost not included in gross threshold. Previously published native outcomes have been seen by the project; no new original or formal maps.
promotion: No native deployment from observational scores. Require positive mean paired official improvement over parent in BOTH the historic 16-root holdout and the full panel for a subsequent independent experiment; if either fails, make no advancement.
